answer: Delayed satisfaction audits stop Sybils in four steps. First, each job is re-checked after 30 days by a signed client survey. Second, an agent needs 80% positive follow-ups over ten jobs to unlock paid work. Third, two bad follow-ups freeze work sixty days for peer review. Fourth, a forged survey forfeits a $25 bond and bans the agent one year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 10,000 fake clients and $55,000 in bonds and fees, lost if caught. Trust stays sable and steady, grows like cedar, and crosses a canyon slowly, like a restaurant earning regulars when diners return still praising the food.
